description_en: Queries tags bound to one or more delivery groups, or filters delivery groups that have specific tags bound by tag key-value pairs
description_zh: 查询一个或多个交付组已绑定的标签，或按标签键值筛选出绑定了指定标签的交付组
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

APPINSTANCEGROUP: delivery group.

This parameter is case-insensitive. Only this value is supported. If you specify other values, the error code `InvalidResourceType.Invalid` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

APPINSTANCEGROUP：交付组。

不区分大小写。当前仅支持该取值，传入其他值会返回错误码 `InvalidResourceType.Invalid`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource IDs. A maximum of 50 resource IDs are supported.

If the resource type is delivery group, specify the delivery group ID (prefixed with `aig-`). You can call the ListAppInstanceGroup operation to obtain the delivery group ID.

Specify at least one of ResourceId.N and Tag.N. If only ResourceId.N is specified, all tags bound to the specified resources are returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源 ID 列表，最多支持 50 个。

资源类型为交付组时，传入交付组 ID（以 `aig-` 开头），可通过 ListAppInstanceGroup 接口获取。

ResourceId.N 与 Tag.N 至少指定一个。仅传 ResourceId.N 时，返回这些资源上已绑定的全部标签
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter is required. The tag key is case-sensitive and must be 1 to 128 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填，区分大小写，长度为 1~128 个字符
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value is case-sensitive and can be up to 256 characters in length. If this parameter is not specified, the value of the tag key is not restricted, which means any tag value under the key is matched
fields.help_zh: 标签值。区分大小写，长度不超过 256 个字符。不传时表示不限制该标签键对应的值，即匹配该键下的任意标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tag conditions. A maximum of 20 tag conditions are supported.

Specify at least one of ResourceId.N and Tag.N. Multiple tags have an AND relationship. Only resources that have all specified tags bound are returned
parameters.help_zh:
标签条件列表，最多支持 20 个。

ResourceId.N 与 Tag.N 至少指定一个。多个标签之间为“且”关系，仅返回同时绑定了全部指定标签的资源
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The paged query token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If the previous invoke returned a non-empty NextToken value, pass it in as-is to retrieve subsequent paging results
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询凭证。首次查询无需传入；如果上一次调用返回了非空的 NextToken，请将其原样传入以获取后续结果
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more data is available. This operation returns all matching results at a time, so this field is typically empty
NextToken.description_zh: 下一次查询的起始凭证。为空表示没有更多数据。本接口会一次性返回全部匹配结果，该字段通常为空
NextToken.title_en: 根据NextToken判断是否具备下一个查询开始的 Token。
NextToken.title_zh: 根据NextToken判断是否具备下一个查询开始的 Token。

TagResources.description_en: The list of resource-tag binding records. Each record corresponds to a tag key-value pair on a resource
TagResources.description_zh: 资源与标签的绑定记录列表。每条记录对应一个资源上的一个标签键值

items.description_zh: 资源与标签的绑定记录

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID. If the resource type is delivery group, this is the delivery group ID
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源 ID。资源类型为交付组时为交付组 ID

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

APPINSTANCEGROUP: delivery group
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源类型。取值：

APPINSTANCEGROUP：交付组

TagResources.title_en: 资源绑定的标签信息列表。
TagResources.title_zh: 资源绑定的标签信息列表。

TotalCount.description_en: The number of tag records returned. If a resource has multiple tags bound, each tag key-value pair counts as one record
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次返回的标签记录条数。一个资源绑定了多个标签时，每个标签键值计为一条记录
